edges.reason: initialize writes the hardcoded proxy registry address into proxyRegistryAddress.
initialize sets basePrice to 30000000000000000.
initialize sets totalSupply to 8989.
initialize increments _tokenIdCounter to start minting at token id 1.
The count parameter drives the payment check and the mint loop in batchMint.
basePrice * count is computed in the batchMint payment requirement, an arithmetic-sensitive multiplication.
batchMint reads current and increments the _tokenIdCounter for every minted token.
batchMint enforces tokenId <= totalSupply against the supply cap state variable.
batchMint mints to msg.sender, the untrusted caller.
batchMint calls _safeMint which invokes the external onERC721Received callback before the loop completes.
isApprovedForAll reads proxyRegistryAddress to build the ProxyRegistry used for whitelisting.
The owner parameter is used to query proxyRegistry.proxies(owner).
The operator parameter is compared against the whitelisted proxy account.
currentToken returns _tokenIdCounter.current().
safeMint mints the new token to the caller-supplied to address.
safeMint compares msg.value against basePrice in a payment requirement.
safeMint reads and increments _tokenIdCounter to obtain the new token id.
safeMint requires tokenId <= totalSupply against the supply cap.
safeMint uses _safeMint which performs an external onERC721Received callback to the recipient.
The from parameter is forwarded from _beforeTokenTransfer to super._beforeTokenTransfer.
The to parameter is forwarded from _beforeTokenTransfer to super._beforeTokenTransfer.
The tokenId parameter is forwarded from _beforeTokenTransfer to super._beforeTokenTransfer.
pause is gated by onlyOwner, which compares the caller (msg.sender) to owner().
unpause is gated by onlyOwner, which compares the caller (msg.sender) to owner().
_authorizeUpgrade is protected by onlyOwner relying on msg.sender for the UUPS upgrade authorization.
withdrawAll forwards the full balance through a low-level send, transferring control to owner() before the call returns.

normalization_plan.reason: The count parameter only exists to drive the batchMint payment check and mint loop.
The to parameter only supplies the mint recipient for safeMint.
The owner parameter is only used to query the proxy registry inside isApprovedForAll.
The operator parameter is only compared against the whitelisted proxy inside isApprovedForAll.
The from parameter is only forwarded to the parent hook from _beforeTokenTransfer.
The to parameter is only forwarded to the parent hook from _beforeTokenTransfer.
The tokenId parameter is only forwarded to the parent hook from _beforeTokenTransfer.
The newImplementation parameter is only received by the _authorizeUpgrade hook.
The loop counter i exists solely to control the batchMint iteration.
The tokenId local is only used to mint inside the batchMint loop.
The tokenId local is only used to mint inside safeMint.
The currentNFT local is only returned by the currentToken function.
The amount local only holds the balance consumed by the withdrawAll send.
The _proxyRegistryAddress local is only used to assign proxyRegistryAddress in initialize.
